has.review: Cse473 has a code /course name issue. You can take cse273 instead for this sem, same course and will be counted as a elective
Firstly, Contact NSU IT and ask them to check your grade sheet. If it has been submitted by your faculty it will be visible on that. If not, the IT will let you know what is wrong with it.

The updated grade takes a few days to resolve. Cause it has to approve by the dean's office first and then the department chair has to approve it then. As it's a weekend is going so it might take few days. You may contact with IT department regarding this issue.

isn.review: Muinul Islam university isn't gonna spoonfeed you. Grow up

Muinul Islam I don't want to judge you but idk where you're coming from. The faculties of ECE department are highly qualified and competent. (At least the ones I came across) They are a gold mine of knowledge if you really want to learn. The thing is you have to reach out to them. University isn't just about doing assignments and passing courses. also if paying money for education is a problem then get a scholarship.

Muinul Islam Given the duration of the semester and also the subject itself, it isn't possible to cover each and every aspect of the subject. For example - one of the most popular trail courses CSE students take part in is CSE445 (Machine Learning). Machine Learning is a vast domain, and covering all theoretical aspects is impossible in 5 months, let alone practical stuff. And, the same case goes for other trail courses as well. So no matter how fine the faculties are, you won't learn everything you need to get started on CSE499. And, the same goes for other CSE trail courses as well. It is impossible for faculties to teach everything about that subject in such a short period of time. So, it's natural no students will be fully competent for CSE499 when enrolling in the course. And, it's invalid if you say our course plans are disorganized. I don't know what your major is, but if you belong to CSE you should know that the subject is very vast, and the university can't and won't teach everything there is related to CSE. University will teach you the basic building blocks, and you'll use those to construct something unique. And, if you fail to do so, you are not fit enough in becoming an engineer. It applies to all reputed universities out there in and out of Bangladesh. So, I'll request the students not to complain about the university and use that time in self studying.
